# `tlgr gif`

5 operations. Every one takes the global flags (`--json`, `--plain`, `-a/--account`, `--results-only`, `--select`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--no-input`, `--flood-wait-max`, `-v`) anywhere on the line.

| Command | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`gif add`](#tlgr-gif-add) | Save a GIF |
| [`gif list`](#tlgr-gif-list) | Your saved GIFs |
| [`gif remove`](#tlgr-gif-remove) | Remove a GIF from the saved list |
| [`gif search`](#tlgr-gif-search) | Search GIFs through the inline GIF bot |
| [`gif send`](#tlgr-gif-send) | Send a saved GIF or a GIF search result |

### `gif add`

Save a GIF.

```
tlgr gif add [CHAT] [MSG_ID]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · idempotent (reports `already`) · returns `GifSaved`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | no | Chat holding the animation. |
| `MSG_ID` | msg-id | any number | Message ids. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | path |  | Upload an animation and save it. |
| `--file-id` | text |  | Save media already on Telegram. |

```console
$ tlgr gif add @alice 12345 --json
```

### `gif remove`

Remove a GIF from the saved list.

```
tlgr gif remove [GIF]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `GifSaved`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GIF` | text | one or more | Document id, or the index `gif list` printed. |

```console

```

### `gif search`

Search GIFs through the inline GIF bot.

```
tlgr gif search <QUERY> [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`LOCAL` cursor) · returns `Page[GifResult]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | text | yes | What to search for. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bot` | user |  | Inline bot to query. |
| `--chat` | chat |  | Query in this chat's context. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

```console
$ tlgr gif search cats --json
```

### `gif send`

Send a saved GIF or a GIF search result.

```
tlgr gif send <CHAT> [GIF] [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `GifSent`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Where to send it. |
| `GIF` | text | no | Document id, or a saved-list index. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bot` | user |  | Inline bot for --search. |
| `--caption` | text |  | Caption text. |
| `--hide-via` | flag |  | Hide the 'via @gif' attribution where allowed. |
| `--pick` | int | `1` | Which search result to send (1-based). |
| `--reply-to` | msg-id |  | Reply to this message. |
| `--save` | flag |  | Also add the sent GIF to the saved list. |
| `--schedule` | datetime |  | Send later. |
| `--search` | text |  | Send from a fresh inline search. |
| `--silent` | flag |  | Send without a notification sound. |
| `--topic` | msg-id |  | Forum topic id. |

```console
$ tlgr gif send @alice 0 --json
```
